card.name: Words just before 'improve' or 'worse'
card.fires_on: Verbs and small words right before a predicted improvement or worsening word, such as 'does not', 'gets', 'feel', 'gotten', 'fail to'. Seen in sentences about whether a condition gets better or worse.

modes.label: Negation before improvement
modes.description: 'not' or 'fail to' after a condition or patient, where 'improve' or 'respond' comes next.
modes.example: If a patient does<< not>> demonstrate clinical improvement, treatment may be extended

modes.label: Change-of-state verbs
modes.description: Verbs like gets, feel, gotten, got that lead into 'better' or 'worse'.
modes.example: Pain that<< gets>> worse when you stand

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict improvement words such as 'improvement', 'improve' and 'improving'.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to say whether a condition got better or failed to improve.
